doc:
Hot-bound all-node rows on lc3_bound's part-max branch: is the added increment an upper bound at singular nodes?  (fea3d 2026-10-20,
found while answering lead 21:15:29Z (4) on TC-04 n42993.)  Python only, no solve; reads the published hot-bound files, the pose
envelopes and the base temperatures.

lc3_bound (results/f1_lc3_hot_bound_v352{g3,h3}.json, _s3d_ for F2) bounds an engine part that is not in its SAME_MESH_ENGINE list
(TC-01, GM-01, GM-02) by  vb(n) = vm_LC1(n) + max over the part's REGULAR nodes of vmD  (the method text: 'conservative away from
idealisation singularities').  At a singular node the node's own increment envelope can exceed that regular maximum, so the stored
all-node row is then not a bound at that node.  Per hot-bound file, part on that branch and state this script records:
  reg_max   the part's regular maximum of the increment envelope over the poses (reproduces the file's part_max_increment; checked),
  all_max   the maximum over ALL the part's nodes,
  delta     all_max - reg_max (>= 0): the most the stored bound can understate the increment at any node of the part,
  node      the stored all-node minimum node: its own increment envelope and the node-wise vM sum there (base vM back-computed from
            the stored MS and the allowables at the node temperature: vm_LC1(n) = vb(n) - reg_max),
  at_node   min(stored, node-wise at the stored node) per slot, unrounded, with 'at_node_lowered' per slot (1e-9 tolerance): the bound AT
            the stored all-node minimum node (used by the matrix:
            it only ever lowers a stored value); brittle: the stored MS with the node's own excess increment (s1 / s3 beyond the
            regular extremes) on the lower brittle allowable at the node temperature, SF 2.0,
  corrected the rigorous corrected all-node bound for the whole part (information): every node m has MS_stored(m) >= MS_min, so with the corrected
            stress <= vb(m) + delta,  MS(m) >= 1 / (1 / (1 + MS_min) + SF delta / a_min) - 1  (a_min = the lowest allowable over the
            part's nodes at that state, base T.npz).  Brittle parts (Weyl s1 / s3 part maxima): delta' = max(delta_s1, -delta_s3) on the
            lower of the two brittle allowables, SF 2.0.
The regular rows are unaffected (the regular maximum bounds every regular node's own increment).  Tags: DERIVED on SIM inputs.
